newsitem.title: FRANCE: Rennes airport Jan-Oct cargo growth strong.
newsitem.headline: Rennes airport Jan-Oct cargo growth strong.

text.p: Rennes-St Jacques airport handled 2,737 tonnes of air cargo and trucked air freight in the first ten months of 1996, an increase of 33.4 percent on 1995 levels, airport authority figures show.

Air cargo totalled 2,524 tonnes, up 39.4 percent on January-October 1995. Air Jet, the airline subsidiary of French air and road express distribution group, Jet Services operates the sole all cargo flight and carried 2,402 tonnes in Jan-Oct or 57.5 percent above 1995 levels.
Trucked airfreight handled at the airport of 213 tonnes was down 11.6 percent on the first ten months of 1995.
January-October 1996 postal traffic handled at Rennes airport totalled 3,940 tonnes, up 11.2 percent on the same period last year. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
